params.prompt: Redraw this kite spirit keeping its design exactly: a lilac silk kite body with cream stitched seams and pale cloud-swirl print, a small calm face in the centre, two long purple ribbon tails ending in gold triangular weights. Clean character reference sheet for 3D modelling: stylised 3D game creature, smooth readable shapes. Plain light grey background, soft even studio lighting, no text, no logo, no ground, no dust, no cast shadows, whole body in frame.
